assistance: LLM-assisted implementation. Model estimates are distinct from NASA observations.
split_note: First fold only; folds are authoritative for each target year.
protocol: Annual past-only replay: for year Y, fit 2013..Y-2 and calibrate intervals on Y-1. 30% NB / 70% five-seed LightGBM; above the pooled fitted MODIS maximum, replace the tree component by its training-fitted factor. NASA long-acquisition-outage weeks have incomplete VIIRS references. Publish identical eligible-week comparisons and all raw weeks. Known development replay after disclosed experiments, not an untouched holdout.
filter: Confidence >=30% MODIS, nominal/high VIIRS; FIRMS types 2/3 excluded. No learned static-source filter. Raw observations retained; documented long acquisition outage references excluded identically from fitting, calibration and comparable scoring.

evaluation.total_error_scope: Mean error of matched eligible-week totals within each test year

features.description: Aggregated detector-only region-week features, including VIIRS reference labels
